summary.whatChanges: In the Vitest UI test explorer summary bar, the "RUNNING (n)" counter is now hidden when viewing a static HTML report, and the summary switches from a two-row grid to a single-row flex layout in that mode. A `data-testid="explorer-summary"` hook was added and covered by an e2e test.
behaviorChanges: Static HTML reports no longer show the 'RUNNING (count)' entry in the explorer summary
Summary layout in report mode renders as a single-line flex row instead of the two-row grid used in live UI mode
Summary container now exposes a data-testid="explorer-summary" attribute in the DOM
E2E test asserts RUNNING is absent in static mode and visible in ui mode
risks: The separator '/' between FAIL and RUNNING is still rendered in report mode, so the summary may read 'FAIL (n) / PASS (n)' with a dangling slash
Layout classes diverge between the two modes, so styling regressions could appear only in one mode
